definition: A budget or pay-plan process that formally set or revised compensation.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 617 distinct documented budget pay plan process implementation events across 391 municipalities in 31 states. A budget or pay-plan process that formally set or revised compensation. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
